data_fields.name: half_interval_movement_shortcut
data_fields.donor_constant: draw interval whole ms shifted right by one; movement removed at TimeToCompleteMovement minus this

best_idea: Run game logic on every loop tick and pace only the draw, carrying the leftover milliseconds into the next draw so the frame cadence does not drift.
decision_why: Take the remainder-carry draw cap as a client quality setting with the fight step on the server tick; reject the 1 ms sleep, the draw-suppress flag and any pacing of movement or the fight step by the draw clock.
acceptance: With draw cap 30 fps, 30 draws happen in one second while input and fight state advance every loop tick; the fight step count is independent of the draw count (test counts ticks and draws over one second).
